name: MessageComposer
summary: Input surface for composing a message.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern: it is a <form> with a text input and a submit button, and native semantics deliver the behaviour — Enter submits because the form does, not because we listened for a key. The input always has an aria-label, since a placeholder disappears the moment you type and so cannot be a name.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the trimmed text, then the field clears itself. Empty or whitespace-only never sends, and the send button stays disabled until there is something to send.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint inside the field. It is not the name — a placeholder disappears the moment you type.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the input, which is what a screen reader reads.

props.name: icon
props.description: Carbon glyph inside the field, before the text.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the send button, which shows only an icon.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and the button together.
